utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the latest, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Vik—can you confirm what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira—that’d help a lot. I’m still trying to figure out what we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — could you bring any spare screws, a screwdriver, and maybe some tape?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list confirmed yet, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I may have missed a few updates, but last I heard they were still collecting stuff for the repair drive. I don’t know the full list yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can still bring a couple of tools over if that’d help, but I don’t have the date, time, or repair list yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — let me know once the date, time, and repair list are set, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the date, time, and repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I still need to pin down the date and time, and the repair list too. I’m sorry, I keep misplacing my toolbox, but I’ll check what’s left right now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still gathering the latest on the repair drive, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — and if you can still bring a couple extra tools, that’d be really helpful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still here—do you still need a couple extra tools for the repair drive, or are you all set?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, a couple extra tools would help. What time are we starting, and should I bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — just send me the repair list when you have it, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair list as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — the repair drive is at the community center on Sunday, and I’ll send the address as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Rosa — I’ll wait for the address and keep Sunday at the community center in mind.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive pick up any new volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send the updated details around and make sure folks know it’s Sunday at the community center. If you can bring that toolbox, we’ll put it to good use.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the updated spot and timing when you have it, and I’ll bring the toolbox.
